newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold, silver sharply up on world trends.
newsitem.headline: India gold, silver sharply up on world trends.

text.p: Indian gold and silver prices were sharply up in early trade on Friday as world market prices showed gains, dealers said.

They said thin supplies of the imported metals and a shortage of ready stock also helped in the rise. "Physical buying however was low but an overnight rally in the global market kept speculators busy," one broker said.

On Thursday gold was down by 10 rupees per 10 grammes while silver was up by five rupees per kg. Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) climbed up by 300 rupees to 57,300 rupees in early trade. They were down by 100 rupees on Thursday.
